name: Skulking Slayer
summary: (Half-Orc Only) Pushed into a life of crime by the society around them, half-orcs gravitate toward criminal activities that suit them best.
replacesText: Weapon/Armor Proficiency; Class Skills; Trapfinding; Rogue Talent; Advanced Rogue Talent; Trap Sense 1-4

features.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
features.summary: The skulking slayer gains proficiency with greatclubs and whips, but loses proficiency with rapiers and hand crossbows.

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: The skulking slayer does not gain Disable Device, Linguistics, and Sleight of Hand as class skills.

features.name: Pass for Human (Ex)
features.summary: At 1st level, when trying to conceal her half-orc heritage, a skulking slayer gains a bonus on Disguise checks equal to half her level. When using disguise to appear as a specific individual, skulking stalkers ignore the normal –2 penalty to appear as another race.

features.name: Underhanded Maneuvers (Ex)
features.summary: At 1st level, when she could normally make a sneak attack, a slayer may instead make a dirty trick or steal combat maneuver with a bonus on her roll. This bonus is equal to her number of sneak attack dice for a dirty trick combat maneuver, or 1-1/2 Ã— her number of sneak attack dice for a steal combat maneuver. This ability replaces trapfinding.

features.name: Bonus Feats
features.summary: At 2nd level, a skulking slayer can select the Surprise Follow-Through feat (see below) in place of a rogue talent. At 10th level, she can select the Improved Surprise Follow-Through feat (if she already has Surprise Follow-Through) in place of an advanced rogue talent.

features.name: Bold Strike (Ex)
features.summary: At 3rd level, when a skulking slayer charges and makes a sneak attack with a two-handed weapon, she rolls d8s instead of d6s for her sneak attack damage. This ability replaces trap sense +1 and +4.

features.name: Shifty (Ex)
features.summary: At 6th level, a skulking slayer gains a bonus on Bluff checks to feint equal to half her level. This ability replaces trap sense +2.

features.name: Unexpected Charge (Ex)
features.summary: At 9th level, a skulking slayer can make a Bluff check to feint as a swift action before a charge. This ability replaces trap sense +3.

features.name: Rogue Talents
features.summary: The following rogue talents complement the skulking slayer archetype: combat trick, surprise attack; combat swipe, powerful sneak; terrain mastery.

features.name: Advanced Talents
features.summary: The following advanced rogue talents complement the skulking slayer archetype: crippling strike; deadly sneak; unwitting ally.
